subject: Open enrollment and direct deposit reminders
text:
All employees,

Open enrollment closes November 20. Also a reminder that direct deposit changes for payroll are made only through Workday self-service, never by emailing HR or Finance. If you receive an email asking you to confirm or change your direct deposit, report it to IT.

Northgate HR
label: ordinary
note: Internal HR announcement; mentions direct deposit changes only as something not to request by email.
